Auth free tiers, compared

WorkOS AuthKit1,000,000MAU0AuthKit free to 1M MAU; +$2,500/mo per additional 1M. SSO and Directory Sync each use the connection ladder ($125→$65). Custom domain $99/mo.source · 2026-10-30
Clerk Hobby50,000MRU050k MRU per app. No SSO. No MFA. Fixed 7-day session.source · 2026-10-31
Logto Free50,000MAU050k MAU / 50k tokens. No Enterprise SSO on Free.source · 2026-10-30
Supabase Auth Free (platform)50,000MAU050k Auth MAU on Free platform plan. No SAML SSO. Project pauses after 1 week inactivity.source · 2026-10-30
Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go50,000MAU—Tier 1 (email, phone, anonymous, social): 0–50k MAU free, then $0.0055 (50k–100k), $0.0046 (100k–1M), $0.0032 (1M–10M), $0.0025 (10M+). Tier 2 SAML/OIDC: 50 MAU free then $0.015/MAU. Phone auth and SMS MFA billed per SMS sent by region (US $0.01, first 10/day not billed). Firebase pricing page: no cost up to 50K MAUs with Identity Platform, then Google Cloud pricing.source · 2026-10-31
Auth0 Free25,000MAU1Up to 25,000 MAU (B2C and B2B identical). 1 Enterprise Connection, Self-Service SSO and inbound SCIM included. Above 25k MAU you need a paid MAU tier (Essentials/Professional) or Enterprise.source · 2026-10-31
Kinde Free10,500MAU110,500 MAU. 1 enterprise SSO connection.source · 2026-10-30
Amazon Cognito Lite10,000MAU—Direct/social: 10k free, then $0.0055/MAU through 100k total, then $0.0046 (from official examples). Federated SAML/OIDC: 50 free then $0.015/MAU.source · 2026-10-30
Amazon Cognito Essentials10,000MAU—Default for new pools. Direct/social: 10k free then $0.015/MAU (official example). Federated SAML/OIDC: 50 free then $0.015/MAU. Passwordless/passkeys included.source · 2026-10-30
Stytch Pay as you go (B2B)10,000MAU510k MAU + 5 SSO or SCIM connections included. Extra connections $125 each. MAU overage rate not printed as a fixed USD figure on the checked page — left blank. Branding add-on $99.source · 2026-10-30
Descope Free Forever7,500MAU37,500 MAU, 10 monthly active tenants, 3 SSO connections, 1 federated app (OIDC). No overages: upgrade required to exceed limits. MFA/step-up included.source · 2026-10-31
